items.text: Nico Collins hurt his hamstring during Wednesday's practice, reported by Houston Chronicle. Missed five games due to a hammy pull back in 2024. Crucial MRI results coming (hopefully) tomorrow. WR routes run last week on 42 CJ Stroud dropbacks: 1. Nico Collins 37 2. Xavier Hutchinson 29 3. Kayshon Boutte 27 4. Jaylin Noel 15 5. Jared Wayne 8.
items.why: Hamstring + prior history; dominant route share shows dependency.
items.implication: If out, targets redistribute to Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel; plan without him W2.
items.opportunity: 37 routes on 42 dropbacks signals clear alpha role when healthy.

items.text: I'm not saying it's likely but as I said in the preseason many times.... #1 RB in fantasy football is within the range of outcomes for Kenneth Walker.
items.why: MNF full-grown-man performance and preseason belief in workhorse role with Mahomes.
items.implication: Start with extreme confidence; RB1 overall ceiling unlocked.
items.opportunity: Confirmed high snap/opportunity share in KC.

items.text: #Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in today’s practice, an indication he could return on Sunday.
items.why: Full participant after missing W1 with ankle; positive return indicator.
items.implication: Potential debut/role expansion; monitor for carries vs Stevenson.
items.opportunity: Full practice clears path to snaps/carries in NE backfield.

items.text: With new information early this week, #49ers and De’Zhaun Stribling make a smart decision and opt to repair his deltoid rupture. Surgery will allow a complete recovery and Stribling should be back in late November or early December.
items.why: Deltoid rupture surgery decision for full recovery; back late Nov/early Dec.
items.implication: Sustained opportunity for Deebo and other SF WRs through midseason.
items.opportunity: Deebo target share boost confirmed longer-term.

items.text: #Bengals QB Joe Burrow told reporters he is dealing with back tightness and didn’t practice today. He got plenty of mental reps and expects to play Sunday.
items.why: Back tightness, DNP Wed but self-reports expects to play; mental reps.
items.implication: Monitor Thu/Fri practice; likely active but watch for limitations. Chase/Higgins value tied.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a waiver wire target this week.
items.why: Stribling long-term injury opens larger role; 21% target share + red-zone looks already in W1.
items.implication: Top waiver priority; instant starter upside in SF offense.
items.opportunity: Elevated target/route share with Stribling out ~10 weeks.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty ascends to high-end RB1 status in fantasy. Tied Bijan for No. 1 Utilization Score at RB in Week 1 (99). 73% snaps, 70% rush attempts, 61% route share into 21% target share, 23 att + 6 tgts, 156 yds scrimmage, 2 rec TDs. UPGRADES to high-end RB1 as every-down player.
items.why: Dominant utilization (snaps/rushes/routes/targets) + efficiency improvements YBC/YAC in new scheme.
items.implication: Lock-in RB1; historical comps with similar shares avg 23+ PPG.
items.opportunity: 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 21% targets, every-down including pass game.

items.text: Early Week 2 Injury Report for Waivers: Ladd McConkey = Tre’ Harris; Ja’Kobi Lane = Rashod Bateman, Chris Moore; A.J. Brown = Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas; De’Zhaun Stribling = Deebo Samuel, Demarcus Robinson; Alvin Kamara = Kendre Miller; plus others.
items.why: Precise injury-driven opportunity mapping for available players.
items.implication: Prioritize these handcuffs/replacements on waivers; Deebo top add.
items.opportunity: Direct snap/target inheritance from OUT/IR teammates.

items.text: As expected, Kenneth Walker went to KC to be a true workhorse. Last night: Handled 29 of the first 32 RB opportunities; Ran 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks; Tied for team-high with 6 targets for a 22% share; 23-173-1 rushing, 3-18-1 receiving result. He fucks.
items.why: Near-total early RB opps + high route/target share in debut confirms three-down role.
items.implication: Elite RB1 upside confirmed; every-down back in Chiefs offense.
items.opportunity: 29/32 early RB opps, 19 routes/33 dropbacks, 6 targets 22% share, goal-line work.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice today due to a hamstring injury.
items.implication: Monitor for role behind or with other DEN RBs; potential limited snaps.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, other backs gain carries.

items.text: 49ers TE Jake Tonges will be out for the season after undergoing surgery for a torn MCL.
items.why: Torn MCL requiring surgery; IR placement.
items.implication: Kittle workload secure/more; SF TE depth thin (Stoll signed).
items.opportunity: Increased red-zone/ dual-TE looks potentially to Kittle or WRs.

items.text: The #Ravens are placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on Injured Reserve after he had wrist surgery to quicken the recovery process. He’s out four games.
items.why: Wrist surgery for quicker recovery; IR designation.
items.implication: Bateman/Moore elevated short-term in BAL WR corps.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes open for remaining Ravens receivers.

items.text: Rashee Rice has a tiny career average depth of target of 4.9 yards. Last night was 2.5 yards. Rice needs serious volume to pay off in box score. The two targets for a 7% share last night are notable. Routes were there though. On 33 Mahomes dropbacks: 1. Xavier Worthy 30 2. Rashee Rice 29 3. Tyquan Thornton 24 4. Cyrus Allen 1.
items.why: High routes (29/33) but tiny aDOT and low target share (2 tgts 7%); volume-dependent profile.
items.implication: Needs more targets to produce; role exists but efficiency/volume watch. ROS adjustment candidate.
items.opportunity: Near-equal routes to Worthy signals involvement; short-area volume key.
